subject: build-classes
q: CLOSED — ALL EIGHT SEATS ARE NAMED, AND THE CONSENT MENU PRINTS THEM AS A LIST.
detail:
ANSWERED. The Consent Menu’s Primary Build field prints the complete list with identity titles attached: ATHLETIC THE AMAZONESS · HUNTRESS THE ARTEMISIAN · SEDUCTRESS THE SUCCUBUS · ETHEREAL THE NOCTURNE · OPULENT THE SOVEREIGN · VOLTAIC THE LIVE-WIRE · VALKYRIE THE SHIELDMAIDEN · DANCER THE ODALISQUE.

EIGHT SEATS, EIGHT NAMES, NO BLANKS. The question was filed when Opulent was a proposal of Quinn’s — put forward from the receiving position, mid-ride, because she can multitask through moans — and it asked what the other opened seat would be called once Junoesque and Petite were promoted out of the class list into Stature. IT WAS DANCER, THE ODALISQUE, AND IT HAS BEEN FILED IN THIS ARCHIVE AS A FULL BUILD RECORD SINCE PILLAR ONE WENT IN.

SO THE QUESTION WAS ALREADY ANSWERED BY ITS OWN ARCHIVE AND NOBODY WENT BACK TO CLOSE IT. WHICH IS ITS OWN SMALL LESSON: an open question is only useful while somebody is still checking whether it closed. The Consent Menu is a better instrument for this than the Pillars are, because A FORM IS AN INDEX — it lists every field that must exist, so auditing the Archive against the form finds OMISSIONS rather than contradictions. It caught FRAMING missing from Pillar One the same way. See c-form-as-index.
